doc.title: Harold Danko interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 28, 2021

title: Opening of the interview with Monk Rowe
summary: Rowe introduces Danko, and Danko jokes about being a promising septuagenarian pianist.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m pleased to have Harold Danko with me today, who is a pianist, composer, and professor emeritus at Eastman School of Music. And I probably left some things out but maybe we’ll get to that.
I refer to myself and say “a promising septuagenarian pianist” you know. I usually apply that adjective to prodigies.
But I’m still promising. I don’t know what I’m promising.
Okay. Well you’ve still got a ways to go then, in your own mind.
